# Stub Creator

> > Stub Creator is an online pay stub generator and payroll management platform for employers, employees, and independent contractors to create, access, and manage paycheck documentation.

The platform provides tools for generating compliant pay stubs, accessing employee portals for major employers, and understanding payroll regulations including W-2 forms, tax withholding, overtime calculations, and state-specific labor laws. Stub Creator serves businesses, self-employed professionals, and workers needing income verification documents.

## Key Topics

- Pay stub generator
- Payroll management
- Employee portal access
- W-2 forms and tax filing
- Income verification
- Payroll compliance
- Check stub creator
- Social Security and Medicare withholding
- Minimum wage laws
- Overtime calculation
- Independent contractor earnings
- State labor laws
- Online pay stubs
- Tax-free overtime 2026
- FLSA compliance

## Tax Filing and Compliance

- [Can I Use Online Pay Stubs to File Taxes?](https://stubcreator.com/can-i-use-online-pay-stubs-to-file-taxes): Using online pay stubs for tax filing with W-2, 1099-MISC, Form 4852
- [How to Calculate Tax-Free Overtime on Your 2026 Paystubs?](https://stubcreator.com/calculate-tax-free-overtime-2026): Calculate $12,500 federal overtime deduction with MAGI, FLSA, W-2 Code TT
- [How Can You Request A W-2 From A Previous Employer?](https://stubcreator.com/request-w2-from-previous-employer): Step-by-step guide to request W-2 wage statements from former employers
- [Check Stub Creator for States with No Income Tax](https://stubcreator.com/states-no-income-tax): Pay stub generation guide for Alaska, Nevada, Texas & no-income-tax states
